not_promotable.reason: ApproveRuns and PrepareToStartRunWithConcurrency do not exist at v1.25.5 (there is no services/actions/approve.go and no run-attempt concurrency code), so the revived-job pre-image cannot be anchored.
services/actions/rerun.go at v1.25.5 contains only GetAllRerunJobs; the rerun path that creates a new attempt and records need_approval is newer, so there is no pre-image.
There is no services/actions/run.go and no workflow-level concurrency preparation at v1.25.5, so the "cancel older runs on insertion" code the fix guards does not exist.

Deferred to a dedicated 1.27.2 SSRF review: the fix is the internal git proxy architecture (modules/egress, modules/proxy, services/gitproxy, proxy envs for every git command) introduced in 1b1274486c40 plus the migration allow-list rewrite, not a per-handler hunk; attributing each CVE to one anchor needs its own pass.
